entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There sure are a lot of high schoolers[n]during the day. They must be targeting[n]them somehow.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Finding the specifics may be difficult.[n]With such a crowd, the odds are[n]against us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right! We're gonna grab 'em by the tail!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, man. We got four of us here,[n]so gettin' something's gonna be simple.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How rude! There are five of us!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You should head over to Central Street,[n]like we planned yesterday, [fName].

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sweet, let's get goin'! Lemme know if[n]you find any shady people!
